question_text: Was the Atlassian Bitbucket and login outage on Nov 23 a hack?
answer_text: Not established. Atlassian says only that it has identified the cause and is working on a fix, and it has not said what the cause is. No one has claimed an attack and we found no report calling it one, but no source has ruled one out.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: An Atlassian post-incident report giving the cause, or a statement from a security authority or an outside investigator.

question_text: What caused the Bitbucket and Atlassian sign-in outage?
what_would_settle_it: An Atlassian post-incident report or other statement naming the cause.

answer_text: Atlassian lists Authentication and user management and Pipelines as partial outages. The website, API and Git access showed operational. It began 10:19 AM ET and was open at 11:12 AM.
label: Confirmed

what_would_settle_it: Atlassian marking the incident resolved on its status page.
